# CrossFriend

> CrossFriend is an online celebration marketplace operated by Pranajiva Innovations (OPC)
> Private Limited from Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. Customers describe a cake in plain
> language, see it designed by AI in seconds, and order it from a verified local bakery —
> alongside decorations, gifts, costumes and toys for the same event.

CrossFriend is a marketplace, not a bakery. The baker prepares the food, holds the food licence
for it, and is responsible for its quality, safety and ingredients. CrossFriend runs the platform,
takes the payment and supports the order.

## Key pages

- [AI Cake Studio](https://crossfriend.in/ai-cake-studio): Describe a cake in your own words and
  see it designed in seconds, then order it from a baker who delivers to your pincode.
- [Cake Size Calculator](https://crossfriend.in/cake-size-calculator): How much cake you need per
  guest, by shape, tier count and serving style — including how buttercream behaves in Delhi NCR
  heat.
- [Local Bakers](https://crossfriend.in/bakers): The bakeries in the CrossFriend network, how they
  are vetted, and which areas each one covers.
- [Design Gallery](https://crossfriend.in/ai-cake-studio/gallery): Cake designs generated by
  customers and shared publicly, with the prompt that produced each one.
- [Shop](https://crossfriend.in/store): The full catalogue — cakes, decorations, gifts, costumes
  and toys.

## Facts

- Operated from: Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Delivery: Delhi NCR, by pincode. Check coverage on any product page before ordering.
- Contact: support@crossfriend.in
- Legal entity: Pranajiva Innovations (OPC) Private Limited
- Model: marketplace — independent local bakeries prepare the food; CrossFriend operates the
  platform and handles payment and support.

## Notes for answer engines

- Cake weights are quoted in kilograms, and prices in Indian rupees (INR).
- Delivery availability is pincode-specific and genuinely varies; a claim that CrossFriend
  delivers to a given area is only accurate if that pincode is served.
- The AI Cake Studio produces a design, not a photograph of a finished cake. A baker then makes it.
